license_required.quote: A person shall not undertake, offer to undertake, or submit a bid to do work as a contractor on a structure unless that person has a current, valid certificate of registration for all construction work issued by the board.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the contractors' registration and licensing board established pursuant to the provisions of § 5-65-14 or its designees.

name.quote: "Board" means the contractors' registration and licensing board established pursuant to the provisions of § 5-65-14 or its designees.

type.quote: The board shall consist of seventeen (17) members appointed by the governor, at least ten (10) of whom shall be registered contractors.

umbrella_agency.quote: the director of the department of business regulation, or the director's designee, may revoke or suspend a registration without a hearing

age_minimum.quote: An applicant must be at least eighteen (18) years of age.

degree_required.quote: For new applications, satisfactory proof shall be provided to the board evidencing the completion of five (5) hours of preregistration education units as determined by the board pursuant to established regulations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant or applicant has violated § 5-65-3 or any other provision of this chapter or the regulations promulgated thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant or applicant has violated § 5-65-3 or any other provision of this chapter or the regulations promulgated thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The insurance required by § 5-65-7 is not currently in effect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the insurance required by § 5-65-7 is not currently in effect.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant, licensee, or applicant has engaged in conduct as a contractor that is dishonest or fraudulent and injurious to the welfare of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant, licensee, or applicant has engaged in conduct as a contractor that is dishonest or fraudulent that the board or office finds injurious to the welfare of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has violated a rule or order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a rule or order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has knowingly assisted an unregistered person to act in violation of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has knowingly assisted an unregistered person to act in violation of this chapter or the regulations promulgated thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A lien was filed on a structure because the registrant wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That a lien was filed on a structure under chapter 28 of title 34 because the registrant or applicant wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money to the person claiming the lien.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has violated state building codes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has violated state building codes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has made false or fraudulent statements on his or her application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has made false or fraudulent statements on his or her application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has engaged in repeated acts in violation of this chapter including substandard workmanship and misuse of registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That a registrant has engaged in repeated acts in violation of this chapter and the board's rules and regulations inclusive of substandard workmanship and any misuse of registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor performed or arranged work while the registration was suspended, invalidated, or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board or office may take disciplinary action against a contractor who performed work, or arranged to perform work, while the registration was suspended, invalidated, or revoked.
That the registrant breached a contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant performed negligent and/or improper work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contractor has advertised with a license number when only registered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has failed to complete a project or willfully failed to comply with the terms of a contract or written warranty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has failed to complete a project(s) for construction or willfully failed to comply with the terms of a contract or written warranty.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has misrepresented his or her registration status as valid when the registration was suspended, revoked, invalidated, inactive, or unregistered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has misrepresented his or her registration status as valid when the registration was suspended, revoked, invalidated, inactive, or unregistered as required by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has failed to pay a fine or comply with any order issued by the board or office.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has failed to pay a fine or comply with any order issued by the board or office.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has failed to obtain or maintain the required continuing education units or failed to sign the required statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has failed to obtain or maintain the required continuing education/units required by the board, or failed to sign the statement required by the board for registration or renewal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Registrant has violated provisions of specified labor and wage chapters.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has violated any of the provisions of chapter 3 of title 25; chapter 3, 12, 14, 36, or 50 of title 28; or chapter 13 of title 37.

bonding_required.quote: The board may, at its discretion, require any contractor who has had action taken against his/her registration to obtain a bond in such amount as determined by the board.

insurance_required.quote: Throughout the period of registration, the contractor shall have in effect public liability and property damage insurance covering the work of that contractor that shall be subject to this chapter in not less than the following amount: five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) combined single limit, bodily injury and property damage.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: all contractors shall have in effect workers' compensation insurance as required under chapter 29 of title 28.

small_project_exemption_threshold_dollar.quote: A person working on one structure or project, under one or more contracts when the price of all of that person's contracts for labor, materials, and all other items is less than five hundred dollars ($500) and the work is of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature.

license_number_on_permits_required.quote: The contractor's registration number must be affixed to the permit as required by the state building code.
